author: spidey simp
description: An experimental stock market simulation featuring tradable companies, player portfolios, market indices, dividends, news events, NPC trading, stock splits, and historical price graphs.
install_msg: SpideyStocks is an experimental stock market simulation and is not currently recommended for general installation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and stock-market simulation data, including user portfolios, share holdings, market configuration, company data, stock prices, and price histories.
